node.statement: Apply the two-sided norm bounds in def-extended-delta-inclusion at amplification n=1 to the nonzero element 1 in C for the replacement from the preceding child. They give (1-c_bar*epsilon_*)||1|| <= ||v_tilde(1)|| <= (1+c_bar*epsilon_*)||1||. Since ||1||=1, comparison of the two endpoints yields 1-c_bar*epsilon_* <= 1+c_bar*epsilon_*, hence c_bar*epsilon_*>=0. Since epsilon_*>0, c_bar>=0.
